loss: Control: equal-image mean Huber on conservative 2-80m references. Parking: 0.8 * equal mean over available Vehicle/Pedestrian x 2-4/4-6m cell means, equal image weight inside each cell, plus 0.2 * control loss.
sampler: Identical for both arms: each batch has one GT-eligible image for each of four critical cells, then four draws from a shuffled broad training stream. Sampling may repeat an image; an epoch has ceil(train_images/8) steps, not a guarantee every unique image is visited.
checkpoint_selection: Lowest dev equal-four-cell macro-image MAE in 2-6m; ties prefer earlier epoch. Held-out evaluation inputs are not in this package.
initialization_policy: Both arms restart from the same previously selected Mini epoch-4 decoder, with fresh optimizer state; no held-out selection or new teacher.
